issuer: the Traffic Branch of the Mauritius Police Force (its Licensing Office)
note: The Mauritius Police Force's page 'Application for Driving Licence' (read 2026-10-30). The Traffic Branch issues and controls driving licences in Mauritius and Rodrigues. One first applies for a provisional driving licence, whose minimum age for a motor car is 18 (motorcycle 17, autocycle 15); the licence follows the practical test, so it is held from 18. An application for a driving licence is made on Police Form PF 31 with a non-refundable application fee of Rs 500, the fee held; the driving test (Rs 500) isn't held. The page gives no term for the licence (null). No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read.

sources.title: Mauritius Police Force, Application for Driving Licence
sources.said: The Traffic Branch of the Mauritius Police Force is responsible for the issue and control of Driving Licences in Mauritius and Rodrigues. ... Application for driving licence shall be made in a Police Form (PF 31) and shall be accompanied by a Non- Refundable application fee of Rs 500. ... Minimum age requirement for a provisional driving licence ... Motorcar : 18 yrs ... Application for driving licence – Rs 500 Driving Test Fee – Rs 500
